subject: math
description: Name angles from diagrams, estimate and measure angle sizes, and write complete angle statements.
learningObjectives: Name angles using one-letter and three-letter notation when appropriate
Identify the vertex and sides of an angle from a diagram
Classify angles as acute, right, obtuse, straight, or reflex
Measure angles from diagrams using degree notation
Write complete angle statements such as m∠ABC = 45°
prerequisites: Identify rays and angles from a diagram
Recognize the vertex of a three-letter angle name
Understand degree notation such as 30°, 90°, and 180°
Use a ruler or protractor carefully when a diagram is provided
